description: Intended behaviour differences between this build and the latest published version. Each entry has `scenario` (a scenario id; `*` matches one path segment), optional `mongoose` (a major version), `paths` (the difference paths it allows; `*` matches one key or index, `**` any rest of the path, e.g. `$.events[*].payload.doc.**`) and `reason`. A scenario that differs passes only when every path at which it differs is allowed. An entry that allows no difference fails the run: remove it once the change is published.

entries.reason: 4.1.2 restores 4.0.2: a failing getUser, getReason or getMetadata is no longer reported to onError (4.1.0 reporting withdrawn, #401); the entry is still written without the value

4.1.2 restores 4.0.2: the plugin reads outside the caller's transaction again (4.1.0 session reads failed every write in a transaction under a non-primary read preference, #401), so an upsert that inserts inside a manual transaction is not seen and not recorded, as in 4.0.2
4.1.2 restores 4.0.2: the plugin reads outside the caller's transaction again (#401), so an upsert that inserts inside a manual transaction is not seen and not recorded, as in 4.0.2
4.1.2 restores 4.0.2: updateMany history is written one entry at a time again (4.1.0 batching withdrawn, #401), so stored entries have 4.0.2's key order
